q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
This week so far (2026-10-12..2026-10-14, partial) is materially smaller than last week: net sales are ₹184,022 vs ₹645,654 last week and orders are 98 vs 339 — the drop is driven by far fewer sessions and orders while ad spend also fell. No single upstream cause passed the automated causal tests, but the data shows sessions, orders and ad spend moved together and a large change in return/PL lines altered the revenue mix.

Evidence
- Summary table
  - Last week (2026-10-05..2026-10-11): Net sales ₹645,654 · Orders 339 · Ad spend ₹430,736 · Net profit -₹68,271 · Net ROAS 0.8
  - This week (partial: 2026-10-12..2026-10-14): Net sales ₹184,022 · Orders 98 · Ad spend ₹121,884 · Net profit -₹4,610 · Net ROAS 1.0

- Main changes and why they matter
  - Sessions and orders fell: Sessions dropped (11,011 → 6,688) and Orders fell from 339 (week) / 115 (recent days) to 98 (this partial week); fewer sessions explain most of the sales decline.
  - Ad spend was lower: Spend fell from ₹430,736 → ₹121,884 in the partial week (same-day association with sales; passed correlation checks but not proven causal).
  - Revenue composition shifted: gross and P&L lines show a large change in return/cancel revenue and contribution margin inside the period — this changed net sales behaviour and made the P&L per-order worse even as headline ad efficiency (net ROAS) rose slightly.
  - No tested upstream cause: the diagnose run did not identify a supported causal driver (sessions, add-to-cart and ad spend moved with sales but could not be proven to have caused it).

Context: Period: 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 vs 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 (this week partial) · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
